decisions.reason: This underground load-haul-dump loader line sits close to the firm's core underground machinery business and a multi-model range is worth retaining unless demand clearly disappoints.
The construction site dumper broadens the construction and transport offering, but it is less distinctive than the firm's more specialized lines so it carries a higher review risk.
The inclined furniture lift line fits the firm's lifting focus, service model and safety-oriented niche positioning, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio.
The inclined building material lift line serves construction customers well and matches the firm's strengths in specialized, practical lifting equipment.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is strategically complementary and differentiated, but its narrower niche and overlap with other lift products make it somewhat more vulnerable than the core lift lines.
